messages:
alyssa: quick heads-up — requesting a soft unpin for runtime v2.14 on the canary cohort to mitigate a surge in tail latency after the sdk-helpers change. @deploybot please hold canary routing until we confirm rollback criteria :eyes:

pj: can you paste the metric spike? curious if it's p95 or p99. also which sdk change triggered this?

alyssa: p95 across canary went from 120ms -> 420ms after the sdk-helpers bump (2024-02-24 03:10 UTC). SDK patch id: sdk-helpers@0.14.2. not seeing error rates increase, just latency.

marco: fwiw our KV cache hitrate dropped ~12% at the same time — might be a prefix hashing tweak. reprod run on staging failed to repro with small load.

devops-bot: deploybot: Received request: soft-unpin runtime v2.14 for canary. Querying pinlist and active routes...

devops-bot: deploybot: Active canary cohorts: eu-west, us-east-ns1. Pinlist contains runtime:v2.14 -> pinned. Proceed with soft-unpin requires ops-ack and >=1 oncall present.

pj: ops-ack from me if we define rollback/hold gates. propose: if p95 increases >200ms over baseline for 5m or error-rate >0.5% for 3m -> immediate rollback to runtime:v2.13 and route to fallback-model. anyone object?

marco: +1 but add a telemetry sanity check: if KV cache hitrate drops >8% sustained for 10m, also trigger rollback. that's the leading signal in staging.

alyssa: sounds good. I'll attach the tiny checklist we ran locally: 

```
- notify oncall (sre-west)
- set canary throttle to 25%
- run smoke load for 30m
- watch p95/p99, error-rate, kv-cache-hitrate
- if gate trips, run `deploybot rollback runtime v2.13 --cohort canary`
```

release-coordinator: adding release window note: performing soft-unpin now, targeting a 1h observation window. I'll broadcast to #general if we roll forward. pls post final decision here. :ballot_box_with_check:

sre-west: oncall ack. I'll watch the dashboards and keep a pager ready. set me as primary for alerts.

devops-bot: deploybot: Action queued: soft-unpin candidate. Manual approval required. To approve run: `@deploybot approve unpin runtime v2.14 --cohort canary --observ-window 1h`

alyssa: approving now @deploybot — please limit traffic to 25% and ensure fallback routing is enabled.

devops-bot: deploybot: Approval received from alyssa. Initiating soft-unpin: lowering canary traffic to 25% and tagging runtime:v2.13 as fallback. Observ window: 3600s.

pj: logging expected rollback command in convo so ops runbook has it: `deploybot rollback runtime v2.13 --cohort canary --reason "latency surge post-sdk-helpers"`

marco: monitoring: first 10m shows p95 at 150ms (baseline ~120) — not yet at gate. kv-cache hitrate initial dip to -6% then recovering.

sre-west: keeping eyes. will escalate if p95 >320ms for two consecutive 5m buckets.

alyssa: if everything stays stable at +30m we can consider gradually restoring traffic. keeping this thread for final decision. thanks all :rocket:
